values.label: Ore
values.description: Raw ore block from the world, the starting point of material processing.

values.label: Dust
values.description: Powdered material obtained by grinding or crushing.

values.label: Ingot
values.description: A standard cast metal bar, the primary form for metalworking.

values.label: Plate
values.description: A flat sheet of material, used for further forming or as a component.

values.label: Alloy
values.description: A mixture of two or more metals, often produced as an intermediate stage.

values.label: Rod
values.description: A long cylindrical piece of material, often used as a component or tool part.

values.label: Sheet
values.description: A thin, flat piece of material, larger than a plate, used in forming.

values.label: Nugget
values.description: A small piece of metal, typically a ninth of an ingot.

values.label: Mold
values.description: A form used to shape liquid metal into ingots or other shapes.

values.label: Bloom
values.description: A porous mass of iron produced in a bloomery, ready for forging.

values.label: Billet
values.description: A semi-finished metal form, intermediate between ingot and wire or rod.

values.label: Crushed Ore
values.description: Ore that has been mechanically crushed into smaller pieces, ready for further processing.

values.label: Double Ingot
values.description: A double-size ingot, often used in efficient smelting or alloying.

values.label: Double Sheet
values.description: A larger sheet, twice the size of a standard sheet.

values.label: Molten
values.description: Liquid metal state, often used in casting or alloying processes.

values.label: Purified Ore
values.description: Ore that has been processed to remove impurities, ready for further refining.

values.label: Tiny Dust
values.description: A very small amount of dust, typically a ninth of a regular dust pile.
